input_timing: Completed candles available at bucket end; current partial candles use only real source and receipt timestamps no later than the decision. Missing inputs stay WAIT.
decision_rule: Every captured SNAPSHOT_INPUT in the registered window (stride_seconds=0). Missing/offline/late-join slots remain in common scheduled denominator. No interpolation of absent calls or source timestamps.
gates: Unchanged existing numeric EARLY/FINAL/core-SCALP gates in frozen fair_forward_shadow.py. This is an input/model candidate, not complete production lock/persistence/exit equivalence.
comparison: First qualified candidate raw gate per lane/contract, compared with separately qualified actual main publications on the same official universe. Raw-gate differences are not attributed solely to a ladder because model/input revision differs. Complete trace and missing-feature cuts retained.
phase_rule: Only development_tuning may be inspected during tuning. Freeze any proposed selection before validation opens. Untouched holdout outcomes stay sealed until its fixed end; identity-invalid or inspected windows cannot certify performance.
fit_rule: Load exactly the preserved artifact after trusted SHA256 verification; recompute its actual fitted-weight hash. No fitting on replay/restart. Serial prediction accumulation. Original331 fit/133 calibration membership; no new labels or hyperparameter changes.
